name: Merchant's townhouse
description: Grand merchant's townhouse, 14.4 x 11.2 m, three storeys and an attic, after the reference pack's Brussels townhouse: a rusticated ashlar ground floor with two arched shop windows, a rendered piano nobile with pedimented windows, iron balconettes and a stone balcony on consoles, a second floor with architraves, a modillion cornice, a slate roof between crow-stepped brick gables with an ornate central gable and dormers. Shop, salon and dining room, two bedrooms, an open attic; two stairs.
